title: If Your Town Sign Changes Overnight… Don't Count #shorts #scarystories
description:
The number on the sign keeps going down.

Follow for a new scary story every night.

#scarystory #horrorstories #creepy #shorts

beats.text: If the sign outside your town changes its number overnight…
Don't try to find out who's missing.
On Monday morning, the sign said 412. Nobody in town seemed to notice.
That night, every phone got the same message.
And the house across the street went completely dark.
At 11:52 PM, your dad texts you from the kitchen.

overlay.message: Did you count us tonight? There should be four.

beats.text: There are only three people in your family.
And someone at the bottom of the stairs just whispered… four.
